name: hd_fs30_grid_pilot
notes: HD^free enhanced hybrid pilot (docs/FS_PILOT.md Sec. 15). Same seed-31 starts at hd_fs30 draws and fixed dense hd_fs30 metric as pilot E and the hybrid pilot (comparability); step-size adaptation (25 iterations, dual averaging) starting at the measured workable 0.025; fast exact likelihood; 8 vectorised chains. Kernel: NUTS + one block-MH sweep (frozen proposals configs/m2/proposals/hd_fs30_v2.json: 30 bins + 8 IRN pairs, fitted from hd_fs30 + pilot E + hybrid pilot, never the released chain) + Metropolised conditional-grid moves (ptagwb.hybrid.make_grid_moves) for bins f_1, f_2, f_3 (three joint moves with the IRN pairs of J1713+0747, J1909-3744, J0030+0451, chosen by scripts/fs_conditional_analysis.py), f_4, f_8; grid 48 + 32 nodes, 5% uniform component. Measured complete post-NUTS update 7.0 s per iteration (bench/bench_grid.py, before adding the two repeated f_3 moves). Relevance declaration frozen: configs/m2/relevance/hd_fs30_released_v1.json. Rules fixed before launch: abort if warmup exceeds 35 min (then relaunch nothing; report); hard sampling cap 2 h (max_sampling_seconds), fewer draws accepted. Success = replicated f_3 entries AND exits (>= 2 chains) plus improved occupancy MCSE vs the hybrid pilot (8 x 100).
